name: selrai-workshop-kit
description: Selr AI workshop kit marketplace. First-party plugins bundled with the kit and installed from the kit at ~/.loup/selr-ai/workshop-kit.

plugins.name: routine-installer-plugin
plugins.description: Package one or more local skills into a working Remote Routine on claude.ai/code/routines: introspect dependencies, extract the credentials it needs, generate setup.sh + .mcp.json, scaffold the repo, and walk through the UI checkpoints. Provides the /package-as-routine command.
